data.gender_notes: Qaabil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qaabil is derived from the Arabic root 'q-b-l', meaning 'to accept' or 'to be capable of'. In Islamic context, it signifies the ability to accept or undertake a responsibility. The name Qaabil carries the meaning “Able, Capable, Competent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Qaabil usually hope their child will grow to embody able, capable, competent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Qaabil is the name of one of the sons of Adam (AS) in the Quran, symbolizing the struggle between good and evil.
data.etymology: Qaabil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Able, Capable, Competent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qaabil total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
